description: This file contains functions for seeding a database with data from JSON files, including reading JSON, normalizing boolean values, upserting roles, competencies, and role-competency relationships into a database using SQLAlchemy ORM, and a main function to conditionally perform seeding based on environment settings.

methods.name: Optional[Any] _read_json(path: str)
methods.description: Reads a JSON file from the specified path, returns the parsed data or None if file is not found.

methods.name: bool _normalize_bool(val: Any)
methods.description: Converts a value to a boolean, recognizing common truthy string representations.

methods.name: int upsert_roles(db: Session, items: Iterable[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Batch upserts role records into the database based on provided items.

methods.name: int upsert_competencies(db: Session, items: Iterable[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Batch upserts competency records into the database based on provided items.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[int],Optional[int]] _resolve_role_and_competency_ids(db: Session, role_ref: Any, comp_ref: Any)
methods.description: Resolves role and competency IDs either by ID or by name from the database.

methods.name: int upsert_role_competencies(db: Session, items: Iterable[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Batch upserts role-competency mapping records into the database.

methods.name: None seed_from_json_if_enabled(db: Session)
methods.description: Main function that conditionally seeds data from JSON files into the database based on environment settings.
